mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines (3-month change < 0), or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.0% for two consecutive months signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand weakness in housing and retail sectors, signaling an impending economic slowdown that drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (3-month change < 0), or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During supply contraction (INDPRO < 95.0), declining industrial output intensifies supply chain constraints and reduces corporate production capacity, eroding profit margins and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises (3-month change > 0), or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During strong demand expansion (RSAFS > 400000 and HOUST > 650), robust consumer and housing activity accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS > 400000 and HOUST > 650, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates dual stress on supply capacity and labor market health, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines (3-month change < 0) and UNRATE rises (3-month change > 0), or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.
